# Dependency advisory overrides — 2026-10-05

Follow-up to the 2026-10-04 refresh. No direct dependency changed; this pass
adds three entries to the root `package.json` `overrides` block to clear the
`bun audit` advisories that upstream dependency ranges still pin. All four
affected packages are transitive devDependencies of the private
`@alaarab/ogrid-docs` Docusaurus site (and, for `braces`, the `tsup` build
tool). None is a dependency of any published `@alaarab/ogrid-*` package, so no
published artifact changes. Package versions and internal references remain
2.17.3; `bun run check:versions` and `bun install --frozen-lockfile` pass.

Each override was added on its own, followed by `bun install`, `bun audit`,
and a full `docusaurus build` of the docs site (63 static pages).

## Overrides added

| Override | Before | Advisory | Pinned by | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tinypool` → `2.1.2` | 1.1.1 | GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3, GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr (critical, prototype pollution to RCE in worker/run options) | `@docusaurus/core@3.10.2` → `^1.0.2` | Docusaurus only loads tinypool for its SSG worker pool, which is off unless `future.faster.ssgWorkerThreads` is enabled (this site does not enable it) and the site has enough pages for more than one thread. A one-off build with a temporary config that turned the pool on and `DOCUSAURUS_SSG_WORKER_THREAD_COUNT=2` rendered all 63 pages through the tinypool 2.1.2 pool (7 pool tasks, `[SUCCESS]`); the regular build also succeeds. A standalone script constructing `Tinypool` with the exact option set Docusaurus passes (`runtime: 'worker_threads'`, `isolateWorkers: false`, `concurrentTasksPerWorker: 1`, `maxMemoryLimitBeforeRecycle`, `workerData`, `resourceLimits`) ran tasks on two workers without error. tinypool 2.x requires Node `^20 \|\| >=22`; CI uses Node 26. |
| `postcss-selector-parser` → `7.1.6` | 6.1.4 (7 copies) and 7.1.6 | GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (moderate, quadratic selector parsing) | cssnano 6 preset plugins (`postcss-unique-selectors`, `postcss-merge-rules`, `postcss-minify-selectors`, `postcss-discard-unused`, `postcss-calc`, `stylehacks`) → `^6`; `postcss-modules-scope` already on 7 | All seven consumers now resolve 7.1.6. After clearing the webpack cache (`packages/docs/node_modules/.cache`, `.docusaurus`) the build's minified stylesheet `assets/css/styles.*.css` is byte-identical to the pre-override output (150,771 bytes, single line, same hash). |
| `katex` → `0.18.11` | 0.16.47 | GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 (low, prototype-pollution bypass of trust restrictions, fixed in 0.18.2) | `mermaid@12.1.0` → `^0.16.47` (via `@docusaurus/theme-mermaid`) | katex is only reached through mermaid's lazy `import('katex')` for math in diagrams; no docs page currently uses mermaid math. The client bundle now contains katex 0.18.11 and no 0.16.47 string. `renderToString` with the options mermaid uses (`throwOnError: false`, `displayMode`, `output: 'mathml'`) renders MathML from 0.18.11 as resolved from mermaid's directory. 0.19.0 was also available but the fix line 0.18.x was chosen to stay closest to mermaid's tested range. |

Override versions are exact rather than caret ranges so the lockfile pins the
audited release; the next scheduled dependency refresh should re-check them.
The `.bun` store may keep a stale `tinypool@1.1.1` directory on machines that
installed before this change; nothing resolves to it and `bun.lock` no longer
references it.

## Remaining advisory

`bun audit` now reports one finding: `braces@3.0.3` (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm,
high, stack exhaustion through deeply nested brace patterns). 3.0.3 is the
latest published version, so there is nothing to override to. It is reached
only through build-time tooling: `micromatch` inside `@docusaurus/utils`, and
`chokidar@3` inside `sass` (a devDependency of the docs site and of the
`react-radix` / `react-fluent` kits, used only to compile their stylesheets)
and `tsup`. Those run on developer machines and in CI over
repository-controlled file globs, never on user input, and none of them is a
runtime or peer dependency of a published package. Revisit when `braces`
publishes a fix or when Docusaurus/tsup move to `chokidar@4`, which dropped the
`braces` dependency.

## Why the published packages are unaffected

The four packages above appear only in the dependency trees of
`@alaarab/ogrid-docs` (private, built to static HTML), of the `tsup` bundler,
and of the kits' `sass` devDependency. No published package lists Docusaurus,
mermaid, cssnano, chokidar, or tinypool in `dependencies` or
`peerDependencies`. Verified after the overrides: `bun run check:exports` (ok:
core=225, inputs=39, react=376, react-radix=314, react-fluent=314,
react-inputs=15, react-xlsx=23), `bun run size` (all six budgets pass with
unchanged sizes), `bunx turbo typecheck` (18/18), `bun run test:all`, and
`bun run lint`.
